title: Education and Work
welcome_lead: Social Organization examines how society structures itself. Education and work are core institutions for discussion.
meta_desc: French: education systems, work, and social structure.
final_note: How a society educates is how it imagines its future.

walkthroughs.body_html: L'ecole primaire, le college, le lycee. After bac, students enter la fac or une grande ecole.
Le taux de chomage = unemployment rate. To discuss: les jeunes diplomes peinent a trouver un emploi.
For 'l'ecole prepare-t-elle au monde du travail?', use evidence: selon l'INSEE. Conclude with nuance.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I play the piano' vs 'I play football'?
options: Je joue le piano, je joue le football.
Je joue DU piano (instrument) vs je joue AU football (sport).
Same preposition for both - 'je joue piano', 'je joue football'.
Je joue le piano, je joue le football.
A verb in the subjunctive mood.
Je joue le piano, je joue le football.
